title: Change the Example
summary: The fun of engineering begins when you change someone else's example!

steps.title: Change the Example

quickCheck.question: In lcd.setCursor(0, 1), which row of a 16x2 display does the cursor move to?
quickCheck.explanation: Because coordinates are zero-indexed, row 0 is the top row and row 1 is the bottom row.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Remember that computers start counting at 0! Row 0 is the top, row 1 is the bottom.

quickCheck.question: When you want to display your robot's name instead of 'Monster Lab!', what should you modify in the sketch?
options: The text inside the quotation marks in lcd.print("...")
The name of the Arduino board in the Tools menu
quickCheck.explanation: The characters inside the quotation marks in lcd.print(...) determine the exact message printed on the screen.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Change the text inside the quotes to print whatever message your monster wants to say!
